# rsc-service `2.0.5` Release Note

Release Location: <!-- not supplied by the user this session — link to build/artifact location -->

md5sum of release file: <!-- not supplied by the user this session — checksum  filename -->

## Important / Breaking Changes
- **A configuration setting has been renamed.** The setting that lists which network
  locations count as "neighbouring country" for roaming-status caching has been renamed
  from `neighbouring-countries-msisdn` to `neighbouring-countries-vlrAddress`. **If your
  environment maintains its own custom configuration on top of the standard release file,
  update it to use the new setting name before deploying this release.** If the old name is
  left in place, it will be silently ignored — the system will fall back to the built-in
  default value with no startup error and no warning in the logs, which could result in the
  wrong caching behavior for your environment going unnoticed.

## Modules Released
<!-- not supplied by the user this session -->
-

## How To Deploy
<!-- not supplied by the user this session — deployment/patch steps, files to replace, config changes -->

## Available Features
N.A — no new capabilities were added in this release.

## Enhancements
- Roaming-status caching now correctly recognizes a subscriber's location even when more
  than one network location is reported for a single lookup, instead of only considering
  the first one.

## Fixed Issues
- **Corrected how long a roaming subscriber's status stays cached.** Previously, the system
  decided the cache duration by looking at the subscriber's own phone number instead of the
  network location (VLR) reported for that subscriber, which could result in the wrong
  cache lifetime being applied (a result was kept either too briefly or too long). This has
  been fixed so the cache duration is now correctly based on the subscriber's actual
  reported network location.
  *(Source: this cycle's change log, not a previously tracked/reported defect — no
  QA-filed bug for this exists to cross-check against, but the fix is confirmed by direct
  source-diff review.)*

## Limitation / Known Issues
- **Daily Error Analysis report**: the downloaded report's `Error %` column can show
  incorrect or inconsistent values for some rows. This is a pre-existing, still-open issue
  and is not fixed in this release.
- **New in this release cycle (not yet resolved):** the background job that generates
  hourly transaction/utilization summary reports can log errors and skip a cycle
  immediately after a fresh deployment or restart, before the first batch of log data has
  been loaded. This is a logging/report-timing issue only — no data is lost, and report
  generation resumes automatically once the first log data is available.

## Tested Areas
This cycle's testing was planned to focus on: how long a roaming result stays cached based
on the subscriber's network location, and the renamed configuration setting above. As of
this report, that testing had not yet been executed — no test-run results are available to
link here.
<!-- link to the test run / execution sheet, once available -->
